items.name: пижама черепашки ниндзя
items.description: This green two-piece set features a racerback tank top and matching boyshorts decorated with Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles graphics, comic book panels, and a "KAPOW!" text design. The top displays a light green polka-dot pattern, while the underwear showcases a large all-over character print.

items.name: пижама спанч боб

items.name: пижама читос
items.description: This two-piece sleepwear set features an orange spaghetti-strap tank top with a Cheetos graphic and yellow trim, paired with yellow shorts covered in an all-over Cheetos logo print and a black drawstring.

items.name: комплект дэйзи дак
items.description: This hot pink two-piece set features a bandeau-style top with an all-over Daisy Duck print and solid pink drawstring shorts with a small Daisy Duck graphic on the leg.

items.name: цветочный боди
items.description: This white, one-piece romper features thin spaghetti straps, a V-neckline with lace trim, and a small central bow detail. The garment is decorated with a delicate, all-over pink floral print.

items.name: розовый комплект с оленятами
items.description: This light pink two-piece set features a long-sleeve top with a scooped lace-trim neckline, a small bow, and a fawn graphic, paired with matching flared pants decorated with an all-over deer print.

items.name: пижама бэмби и топотун
